As Amazon (AMZN) Market Valuation Rose, Oakworth Capital Has Upped Position; Starbucks (SBUX) Holder Aqr Capital Management Decreased Its Holding 
April 17, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers 
Cliff Asness decreased its stake in Starbucks Corp (SBUX) by 9.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aqr Capital Management Llc sold 238,112 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.28% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Cliff Asness held 2.37 million shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $136.01M, down from 2.61M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aqr Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Starbucks Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $84.25 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.86% or $0.51 during the last trading session, reaching $59.94. About 4.39 million shares traded. Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) has risen 0.40% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.15% the S&P500. 
Oakworth Capital Inc increased its stake in Amazon (AMZN) by 211.73% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
